# SwiftPieces

> SwiftPieces (swiftpieces.com) is a free library of 85 SwiftUI components for iOS in 14 categories: animated, gesture-driven interactions such as a swipeable card stack, Liquid Glass (iOS 26) menus, a floating tab bar, interactive charts, form inputs and AI chat surfaces. Each piece is one self-contained Swift file (plus a .metal file where a shader is involved) on Apple frameworks only, from iOS 17. Install by copy-paste, `npx swiftpieces add <Name>`, or the SwiftPieces MCP server.

Key facts:

- License: MIT + Commons Clause. Free for personal and commercial apps, including client work. Source-available rather than OSI open source: the pieces themselves may not be sold or redistributed.
- No dependencies and no Swift package: the CLI copies source files into a SwiftPieces folder in the app, and they become the developer's own code.
- iOS 17 baseline. Liquid Glass pieces gate glass with `#available(iOS 26, *)` and fall back to Material.
- One motion language across every piece: five spring tiers with named roles, gesture releases that keep the finger's velocity, rubber-band limits and a Reduce Motion substitute for every movement (https://swiftpieces.com/docs/guides/swiftui-motion).
- States and accessibility are built in (Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion, Reduce Transparency), with haptics (sensoryFeedback) where an interaction calls for them.
- Source: https://github.com/Saivion/SwiftPieces

Rules for Liquid Glass: gate with `#available(iOS 26, *)` and a Material fallback; wrap multiple glass views in one `GlassEffectContainer`; apply `.glassEffect` after layout modifiers; respect `accessibilityReduceTransparency`; never use invented modifiers such as `.liquidGlassUltra`.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/introduction)
- [Installation](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/installation)
- [CLI](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/cli)
- [MCP and agents](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/mcp)
- [SwiftUI Liquid Glass guide](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/liquid-glass)
- [Registry index (JSON)](https://swiftpieces.com/r/index.json)
- [Free MCP endpoint](https://swiftpieces.com/api/mcp): search_pieces, get_piece, install_piece, list_categories, get_liquid_glass_guide
- [Full text for LLMs](https://swiftpieces.com/llms-full.txt): every piece's notes and parameters, and every guide

## Tools

- [Playground](https://swiftpieces.com/apps): App Store apps remixed as original SwiftUI screens to try, take apart and remix in the browser. Five are free; the rest come with Pro.
- [Styles](https://swiftpieces.com/styles): make one style for every screen (accent, light and dark, iOS fonts, corners, cards, buttons, spacing, motion) on live SwiftUI components. A style travels as a short code (SP2-…) that the Playground's Style tab and its `?style=` links read, and exports as Theme.swift.

## Guides

- [SwiftUI Animations: A Practical Guide with Examples](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/guides/swiftui-animations): SwiftUI animations explained with working examples: implicit and explicit animation, spring animation, transitions, keyframe animators, and gestures.
- [SwiftUI Motion: Springs, Rubber Banding and Gesture Momentum](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/guides/swiftui-motion): How to make SwiftUI motion feel physical: spring tiers, finger tracking, velocity that carries into the release, rubber banding and Reduce Motion.
- [SwiftUI Buttons: Custom Styles, Animation, Loading](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/guides/swiftui-buttons): SwiftUI buttons from the basics to custom ButtonStyle, press animation, haptics, async loading states, hold to confirm, and accessible hit targets.
- [SwiftUI Cards: Card Views, Swipe Stacks and Flip Cards](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/guides/swiftui-cards): Build SwiftUI cards that feel native: continuous corners, layered shadows, press states, a swipeable card stack, a 3D flip card, tilt and scroll parallax.
- [SwiftUI Haptics: sensoryFeedback and Haptic Feedback](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/guides/swiftui-haptics): A practical guide to SwiftUI haptics: sensoryFeedback triggers, conditions and feedback kinds, drag threshold ticks, UIKit generators, and restraint.
- [SwiftUI Skeleton Loading, Shimmer and Loading States](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/guides/swiftui-loading-states): SwiftUI skeleton loading with redacted placeholders, a shimmer modifier, ProgressView styles, success and failure morphs, paging footers and Reduce Motion.

## Patterns

Whole sections of an iOS screen: chats, composers, nav and tab bars, lists, settings, forms, sheets, sign-in and checkout, laid out, wired and given their states, themed by SwiftPieces Pro's design system. All 46 come with SwiftPieces Pro and install with a Pro license. All patterns: https://swiftpieces.com/patterns

- [Plan and Usage](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/patterns/settings/plan-usage) (Pro): The subscription section of Settings: the plan and its renewal, usage meters that warn near a limit, and the way up. Inside: Plan with its status and renewal, Usage meters that warn near a limit, Upgrade with its states, Manage subscription and restore. Install with a Pro license: `npx swiftpieces add PlanUsageBlock`. In SwiftPieces Pro: https://pro.swiftpieces.com/library/patterns/plan-usage
- [Invite Friends](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/patterns/settings/invite-friends) (Pro): A referral section: what both people get, a track that fills as friends join, the invite code to copy or share, and who you invited. Inside: Reward and a track that fills per friend, Invite code you copy, Share invite, Invited friends with their status. Install with a Pro license: `npx swiftpieces add InviteFriendsBlock`. In SwiftPieces Pro: https://pro.swiftpieces.com/library/patterns/invite-friends
- [Sign In](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/patterns/auth/sign-in) (Pro): The sign-in section of a welcome screen: email and password, Sign in with Apple, a passkey and Create account in one block. Inside: Email and password with autofill, Sign in with its working, done and failed states, Sign in with Apple and a passkey, Forgot password and create account. Install with a Pro license: `npx swiftpieces add SignInBlock`. In SwiftPieces Pro: https://pro.swiftpieces.com/library/patterns/sign-in
- [Stats Overview](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/patterns/dashboards/stats-overview) (Pro): The top of a dashboard: a headline metric and its change, a chart you scrub across 1W to 1Y, and metric tiles. Inside: Headline metric and its change, Chart you scrub, Range control from 1W to 1Y, Metric tiles. Install with a Pro license: `npx swiftpieces add StatsOverviewBlock`. In SwiftPieces Pro: https://pro.swiftpieces.com/library/patterns/stats-overview
- [Checkout](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/patterns/commerce/checkout) (Pro): A one-column checkout: bag with steppers, address and delivery speed, promo code, summary, then Pay or Apple Pay to the placed order. Inside: Bag with quantity steppers, Address and delivery speed, Promo code and a total that follows, Pay and Apple Pay to the placed order. Install with a Pro license: `npx swiftpieces add CheckoutBlock`. In SwiftPieces Pro: https://pro.swiftpieces.com/library/patterns/checkout
- [Account Settings](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/patterns/settings/account-settings) (Pro): The account section at the top of Settings: profile and photo, appearance, notifications, your data, sign out and deletion. Inside: Profile with photo and name, Appearance in your theme's colours, Notification toggles, Your data, sign out and delete account. Install with a Pro license: `npx swiftpieces add AccountSettingsBlock`. In SwiftPieces Pro: https://pro.swiftpieces.com/library/patterns/account-settings
- [Chat Thread](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/patterns/ai-chat/chat-thread) (Pro): The message list of an assistant chat: replies in light markdown that stream in with Stop, then Copy, Regenerate, rate and Share. Inside: Streaming replies with Stop, Light markdown with Copy, Copy, Regenerate and feedback, Failed reply with Retry. Install with a Pro license: `npx swiftpieces add ChatThreadBlock`. In SwiftPieces Pro: https://pro.swiftpieces.com/library/patterns/chat-thread
- [Chat Welcome](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/patterns/ai-chat/chat-welcome) (Pro): The start of a new assistant chat: a greeting, suggestion cards by intent that page sideways, Shuffle, and recent chats to continue. Inside: Time-of-day greeting, Prompt cards that page, Shuffle suggestions, Recent chats. Install with a Pro license: `npx swiftpieces add ChatWelcomeBlock`. In SwiftPieces Pro: https://pro.swiftpieces.com/library/patterns/chat-welcome
- [Chat History](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/patterns/ai-chat/chat-history) (Pro): Past assistant chats: live search, Pinned and date groups, swipe and context actions, inline rename and delete that confirms. Inside: Live search, Pinned and dated groups, Swipe and hold actions, Rename and delete. Install with a Pro license: `npx swiftpieces add ChatHistoryBlock`. In SwiftPieces Pro: https://pro.swiftpieces.com/library/patterns/chat-history

Inside: Photo layouts with +N, File chips, Upload rings with Retry, Full-screen photo viewer. Install with a Pro license: `npx swiftpieces add AttachmentChatBlock`. In SwiftPieces Pro: https://pro.swiftpieces.com/library/patterns/chat-attachments

## Collections

- [SwiftUI text effects](https://swiftpieces.com/components/text): Free SwiftUI text effects for iOS: animated text reveal with highlights, Liquid Glass text and expandable Read more text. One Swift file each, no dependencies. (4 pieces)
- [SwiftUI animated backgrounds](https://swiftpieces.com/components/backgrounds): Free animated SwiftUI backgrounds for iOS: a Metal shader silk surface with device-tilt lighting and an interactive Canvas dot grid with haptics. (2 pieces)
- [SwiftUI Liquid Glass components](https://swiftpieces.com/components/glass): Free SwiftUI Liquid Glass components for iOS 26: glass surface, segmented control and floating action menu, each with a Material fallback for iOS 17. (5 pieces)
- [SwiftUI buttons and controls](https://swiftpieces.com/components/controls): Free custom SwiftUI buttons and controls for iOS: animated button styles, an async loading button, hold to confirm, a timer dial and more. With haptics. (7 pieces)
- [SwiftUI input fields and form controls](https://swiftpieces.com/components/inputs): Free SwiftUI inputs for iOS: floating label text field, password strength field, currency field, token field, date range picker, range slider and map location picker. (17 pieces)
- [SwiftUI cards](https://swiftpieces.com/components/cards): Free SwiftUI card components for iOS: a swipeable card stack, 3D flip card, device-tilt motion card and parallax image card. One file each, with haptics. (5 pieces)
- [SwiftUI lists and carousels](https://swiftpieces.com/components/lists): Free SwiftUI list components for iOS: custom swipe action rows, a swipeable task row, status timeline, depth paging carousel and an infinite scroll list. (7 pieces)
- [SwiftUI navigation components](https://swiftpieces.com/components/navigation): Free SwiftUI navigation components for iOS: a floating tab bar dock, paging tabs with a scroll-tracking indicator and a stretchy header that pins to the nav bar. (7 pieces)
- [SwiftUI sheets and toasts](https://swiftpieces.com/components/sheets): Free SwiftUI sheet components for iOS: a confirmation bottom sheet, a pre-permission sheet, a toast with undo and a spotlight coach mark tour. Haptics included. (5 pieces)
- [SwiftUI feedback and loading states](https://swiftpieces.com/components/feedback): Free SwiftUI feedback components for iOS: skeleton loading with shimmer, loading to success checkmark animation, success and error screens, like button, star rating. (5 pieces)
- [SwiftUI gesture and motion modifiers](https://swiftpieces.com/components/motion): Free SwiftUI motion modifiers for iOS: drag to dismiss for photos, cards and sheets, with velocity-based springs, a styled scrim, haptics and Reduce Motion. (1 pieces)
- [SwiftUI charts and data components](https://swiftpieces.com/components/data): Free SwiftUI data components for iOS: an interactive line and bar chart, scrubbable donut chart, streak heatmap calendar, rolling odometer and KPI stat tiles. (6 pieces)
- [SwiftUI AI chat components](https://swiftpieces.com/components/ai): Free SwiftUI AI chat components for iOS: streaming text reply, thinking indicator, prompt suggestion chips, answer sources and citations, and Metal shader orbs. (6 pieces)
- [SwiftUI photo and media components](https://swiftpieces.com/components/media): Free SwiftUI media components for iOS: a full-screen photo viewer with pinch to zoom and drag to dismiss, a photo cropper and a Stories progress bar. (8 pieces)
- [SwiftUI animations](https://swiftpieces.com/components/animations): Free animated SwiftUI components for iOS: card stacks, 3D flips, text reveals, rolling numbers, loading morphs and spring buttons. One Swift file each. (16 pieces)
- [SwiftUI components with haptic feedback](https://swiftpieces.com/components/haptics): Free SwiftUI components with haptic feedback built in: buttons, sliders, dials, ratings, sheets and gestures that tick, tap and confirm with sensoryFeedback. (33 pieces)

## SwiftPieces Pro

A separate paid library for building whole apps: 54 screens, 48 flows, 12 app templates and a 31-item Build Kit (production-ready SwiftUI screens, flows that string them into whole journeys from first run to settings, complete Xcode projects, and agent skills that build the rest in the same design) at https://pro.swiftpieces.com/library, plus Pro remixing in the Playground at https://swiftpieces.com/apps (all 34 apps, remix any app with AI, keep up to 100 remixes). One plan with lifetime access; plan and pricing: https://pro.swiftpieces.com/pro. Pro MCP endpoint: https://pro.swiftpieces.com/api/mcp (license key required): search_library, get_item, list_kit, get_kit_item, apply_design_skill, apply_recipe.

Tap, hold to repeat with acceleration, or scrub sideways across the pill for velocity-scaled steps while a ruler slides under the finger; at a bound that button melts into the pill and the pill strains against the stop, and the button buds back out the moment it can be used. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add ScrubStepper`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/ScrubStepper.json
- [Secure Entry](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/inputs/secure-entry): A liquid glass password field with a focus ring and a round glass reveal bubble joined to it that keeps focus. Typing buds a strength chip out of the field that morphs its label from weak to strong beside a growing gauge, requirement chips bud out of the field and turn sage with drawn checks as each rule passes, and when all pass the field takes a sage tint with a check while the chips melt back into it; a refused entry shakes the field, tints it butter and buds an error chip joined below it. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add SecureEntry`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/SecureEntry.json
- [Signature Pad](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/inputs/signature-pad): A signature field that lays smooth, velocity-weighted ink into a Canvas as the finger moves, thinning on quick flicks and pooling on slow turns, over a baseline whose Sign here hint fades on the first stroke. Under the paper floats one liquid glass toolbar: Undo buds out of one end of the Type instead pill and Clear out of the other the moment they can act, joined to it by liquid necks, and melt back into it when they can't; the pill morphs to Draw instead, and a sage glass Signed chip lands once the signature counts. Undo after Clear, strokes that rescale with the pad on rotation, and export to a transparent PNG or a vector PDF. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add SignaturePad`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/SignaturePad.json
- [Swatch Picker](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/inputs/swatch-picker): A row of color swatches for tags, lists, calendars and themes. The selection ring flows to the swatch you tap like liquid, its leading edge reaching the new swatch first and the trailing edge following, and a check pops into the picked swatch in ink or white, whichever reads on it. Each swatch is a named color, so VoiceOver reads its name; the defaults are the SwiftPieces house blocks. A row wider than the screen scrolls. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add SwatchPicker`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/SwatchPicker.json
- [Time Slot Picker](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/inputs/time-slot-picker): Bookable times as a grid of liquid glass pills, formatted in the user's locale and clock. The red selection flows to the time you tap like liquid, along a row or across rows: the edges facing the new slot lead and the far edges follow, so it stretches toward the pick and gathers in, while the label under it turns to ink. Taken times are outlined and struck through, and a tap on one shakes it with a firm tick instead of selecting it. For appointments, tables, classes and deliveries. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add TimeSlotPicker`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/TimeSlotPicker.json
- [Token Field](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/inputs/token-field): A liquid glass tag and recipient field where each committed entry buds out of the glass input as a glass chip, born where it was typed while the input slides on, and chips wrap across lines resting apart while the input takes the rest of the last line. Return, comma or a paste of a whole list commits trimmed tokens with duplicate, limit and validation checks; backspace on an empty input highlights the last chip in the brand red and a second press melts it back into the input; and a glass suggestion list buds out of the input and filters as you type. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add TokenField`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/TokenField.json

## Lists (https://swiftpieces.com/components/lists)

- [Depth Carousel](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/lists/depth-carousel): Paged cards that recede in depth as they leave center and hand each page a phase value for inner parallax. A held neighbor starts forward and comes to center on tap. Underneath, a glass page counter joined by a liquid neck to a scrubbable glass track, whose tinted glass pill stretches between the dots as the pages move, flattens against the ends and follows the finger when scrubbed, computed in absolute page coordinates so it never jumps. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add DepthCarousel`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/DepthCarousel.json
- [Drag Select Grid](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/lists/drag-select-grid): A multi-select photo and file grid where one drag paints a whole reading-order range the way the system photo library does, a sideways drag or a short hold starts painting while vertical swipes still scroll, dragging back unpaints, starting on a selected item deselects, the grid auto-scrolls faster the deeper the finger sits in the top or bottom edge, and selected cells inset under a liquid glass badge that buds out of the print's corner, floods signal red as the check stamps down and melts back into the corner, with a haptic tick per item. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add DragSelectGrid`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/DragSelectGrid.json
- [Follow Scroll](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/lists/follow-scroll): A chat, log and live-feed scroll container that opens on the newest item and stays pinned to it while the reader is at the bottom, but never yanks them away once they scroll up to read; items that arrive below are counted into a liquid glass pill that buds up out of the bottom edge on a neck, jumps back to the latest and melts back down into the edge once the reader is caught up, older items loaded at the top keep the visible row exactly where it was while a glass spinner buds down from the top edge, and keyboard, rotation, growing rows and removals all hold the reader's place. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add FollowScroll`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/FollowScroll.json
- [Paged List](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/lists/paged-list): An async/await infinite-scroll list that prefetches the next page a few rows before the end, never runs two loads at once, drops duplicate ids across pages, ignores stale responses after a refresh or cancel, and shows pulsing skeleton rows; its footer is one liquid glass bubble that spins while a page loads, widens into a "Couldn't load more" pill with a Retry bubble budding out of it on a liquid neck that keeps loaded rows, and becomes a quiet "You're all caught up" pill at the end, with pull to refresh that replaces rows only on success. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add PagedList`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/PagedList.json
- [Status Timeline](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/lists/status-timeline): A vertical status timeline on liquid glass nodes: the live node is tinted and breathes, completed ones stamp to a tinted check as the ink runs down the line to the next stop, and a step's detail buds out of its node as a glass panel joined to it, melting back in as the relay moves on. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add StatusTimeline`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/StatusTimeline.json
- [Swipe Action Row](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/lists/swipe-action-row): Wraps any row in a liquid glass card whose swipe actions are tinted glass bubbles. As the card slides they bud out of its edge, joined to it and to each other by liquid necks, and melt back in as it closes; the card lands in its detent at the speed you let go, a full swipe clicks in with a haptic as the edge bubble swallows the others and takes the bar, a destructive one carries the card out of the row, and a shared binding keeps one row open at a time. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add SwipeActionRow`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/SwipeActionRow.json
- [Task Row](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/lists/task-row): A task card with liquid glass chrome. Its check is a glass bubble, stamped in ink and popping as the check draws while the card flashes into a solid block, then settling to tinted glass as the row compacts; the priority sits on a tinted glass chip; a swipe-right buds a complete bubble out from under the card that completes with a strike-through; a swipe-left buds Snooze and Delete bubbles that part to rest apart; and a long-press lift reports reorder moves. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add TaskRow`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/TaskRow.json

Scrub the track with a swelling thumb while the times follow, skip with a letter by letter title morph and a blurred artwork swap, and drag the card down to fold it back into the bar. Playback stays the app's: the piece shows the time it is given and reports taps, skips and seeks. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add NowPlaying`. Tap a dot to jump, or scrub along the row with a tick for every page you cross. Autoplay fills the capsule as a timer and turns the page when it is full, pausing while a finger is down. Optionally on a liquid glass capsule, for dots over photos. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add PageDots`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/PageDots.json

(iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add ScrollIsland`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/ScrollIsland.json
- [Step Trail](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/navigation/step-trail): A liquid glass progress trail for checkout, booking, account setup and verification flows: every step a glass stop joined to the next by a short neck, done steps carrying a check, the current step a red capsule with its number and title, steps people already reached in full text and the rest muted; moving on stretches the red from one stop to the next and gathers it there while the old title blurs into a check, a tap goes back to any step already reached, a tap ahead of that shakes the stop and nothing moves, a sideways drag carries the capsule stop by stop with a tick each and gives at the last step it may reach, and when the titles don't fit the capsule keeps its number, the caption names the step and the stops shrink rather than wrap or clip. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add StretchHeader`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/StretchHeader.json
- [Tracking Tabs](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/navigation/tracking-tabs): Tabs on a liquid glass track over a paging ScrollView. The indicator is a signal-tinted glass capsule in the same liquid as the track, riding the pages through fractional scroll progress and swelling a little while it travels, with title ink that turns exactly under its edge, optional counts, a pressed state that sinks it with the selected title, and a selection tick each time the page changes. Taps reach the real control (which can also advance the tour), stops that aren't on screen are skipped, the cutout follows its target through scrolling, rotation and the keyboard, the tour can show itself only once, and VoiceOver, hardware keyboards and Reduce Motion stay in step. Placed inside the safe area so it clears the Dynamic Island and rides above the keyboard. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add Toast`. ## Text (https://swiftpieces.com/components/text)

- [Expandable Text](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/text/expandable-text): A paragraph clamped to a line limit that measures whether it is really truncated, and only then fades the end of its last line into a small liquid glass "more" pill; tapping grows the block smoothly to its full height with no reflow while the pill rides its bottom edge down and morphs to "less", links stay tappable, and VoiceOver always reads the whole text. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add ExpandableText`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/ExpandableText.json
- [Glass Text](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/text/glass-text): Liquid Glass rendered on the actual glyph outlines of a string, one or several lines, set in the house semibold by default, with a specular frosted fallback below iOS 26, a solid fill under Reduce Transparency and Dynamic Type scaling. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add GlassText`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/GlassText.json
- [Picture Headline](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/text/picture-headline): A semibold headline with living pictures stuck between its words like a hand-placed collage. Each word rises into place and each picture opens from a dot into a tilted sticker with a white rim, landing with a spring, a light tick and a flash of crop marks, then keeps drifting. Press a sticker to lift it. Use the built-in house-palette scenes (the sun is our red mascot), your own images or SF Symbols; it wraps like text at any width and Dynamic Type size. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add PictureHeadline`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/PictureHeadline.json
- [Text Reveal](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/text/text-reveal): Reveals a headline by characters, words or lines, rising from a baseline mask with a stagger sized to land in under a second, then grows a stroke of tinted liquid glass behind each phrase that matters, the text flipping to ink exactly under its edge. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add TextReveal`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/TextReveal.json
